title: Seal in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#7a9cc6'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#b8d4f0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#7a9cc6'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#b8d4f0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='35' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='35' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='33.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='33.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2e2e4e'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='44' y1='43' x2='30' y2='40' stroke='#d0e4f7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='46' x2='30' y2='47' stroke='#d0e4f7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='43' x2='70' y2='40' stroke='#d0e4f7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='46' x2='70' y2='47' stroke='#d0e4f7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M28 50 Q50 58 72 50 L70 58 Q50 66 30 58 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='62' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M31 64 Q28 74 24 80 L32 80 Q36 72 37 64 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M33 55 Q50 62 67 55' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M34 64 Q48 70 66 64' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#5f82ad' transform='rotate(20 22 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#5f82ad' transform='rotate(-20 78 70)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 82 Q82 86 88 80 Q84 90 74 88 Z' fill='#5f82ad'/>
  <path d='M72 82 Q62 80 60 74 Q66 84 78 82 Z' fill='#5f82ad'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='3' fill='#e88a9d' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='3' fill='#e88a9d' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
